Default.note: The zero-prop default ('Thinking') at text-chat/medium in muted ink, with the gleam band caught mid-sweep in the capture — the leading glyphs are visibly brighter, so the .thinking-text motion CSS is confirmed to have shipped in the bundle.

Labels.note: Four realistic agent labels of increasing length (Thinking, Planning the migration, a file path, a build command). Each is at a different point in the gleam cycle, which is exactly the un-synced behaviour.

InChatTurn.note: The component in its real chat position: avatar, thinking label, and a text-chat-meta line underneath. Shows the intended relationship between the thinking label and the turn metadata.

WithSpinner.note: Thinking label beside a Spinner inside a bordered activity strip — the 'agent is working' composition. Spinner and label share the same optical size and baseline.

InPhaseSync.note: Three copies with the same motionOriginMs — in the capture all three gleams sit at the identical phase, which is precisely what that prop is for, so this axis genuinely demonstrates itself in a still frame.
